viewing_check: Open the box and check all numbered bags are present and sealed or counted, the manual and sticker sheet are there, tyres and the Technic panels are intact. Sealed numbered bags would lift the value a lot; a loose or part-built set is worth far less. Photograph the box underside for a serial and any resealing.
